In the context of supervised image classification with over-parameterized convolutional networks (VGG19 and ResNet50), researchers sought initialization schemes that permit training highly sparse subnetworks to high performance without requiring repeated full-model search per target task. Prior practice produced winning-ticket initializations by performing iterative magnitude pruning and resetting within the same dataset/optimizer as evaluation; this approach is computationally costly (many full-model re-trainings, e.g., 30 pruning iterations) and leaves open whether the discovered initialization encodes only dataset-specific information or a broader inductive bias. If winning tickets were dataset-specific, then each new target dataset would require the same expensive search, preventing amortization; if they were generic, a small set of winning tickets could be reused. Prior work did not systematically test cross-dataset transfer within the same data domain, so it was unknown whether tickets from large datasets like ImageNet embed transferable structure useful across varied natural-image classification tasks.

values: 大型自然图像源数据集得到的中奖彩票可迁移到自然图像目标数据集，性能接近目标任务专用彩票

在大型、复杂的自然图像源数据集（ImageNet、Places365，以及较弱程度上的 CIFAR-100）上，通过迭代量级剪枝发现的中奖彩票初始化（每轮剪枝率 0.2，最多 30 轮，并延迟重置到训练早期参数），用于在其他自然图像目标数据集（SVHN、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、ImageNet、Places365）上训练相同的 VGG19 或 ResNet50 架构时，往往能取得接近直接在目标数据集上发现的彩票的测试准确率。这种迁移在广泛的剪枝比例下都能观察到，包括极高稀疏度；大型、类别更丰富的源数据集通常比小型源数据集产生更强的跨数据集迁移，例如训练样本数相同的 CIFAR-100 彩票比 CIFAR-10 彩票泛化更好。
该结论得到较充分实证支持。观察 H1 表明，迁移彩票能够缓解 Fashion-MNIST 目标任务特有的过拟合；H2 则表明迁移模式在 VGG19 和 ResNet50 两种架构上保持一致，从而增强了架构无关效应的可信度。但源数据集“复杂度”这一概念仍需更严格操作化；除类别数外，样本量和任务难度等因素也可能混杂。
源数据集规模和类别数量可预测中奖彩票的可迁移性
在 VGG19 和 ResNet50 两种架构上，从训练样本更多、输出类别更多的大型源数据集中发现的中奖彩票，迁移到其他自然图像分类数据集时，明显优于从小型源数据集中发现的彩票。这一效应不能只用原始训练集大小解释：在训练样本数相同的情况下，类别更多的 CIFAR-100（100 类）产生的彩票，比类别较少的 CIFAR-10（10 类）产生的彩票在多个目标任务上泛化更好。
观察 H3 表明，不同目标数据集和两种架构上，源数据集有效性的排序相当一致。但 weakpoint P1 指出 CIFAR-10 与 CIFAR-100 的比较并未控制类别数以外的数据属性，因此“类别数量独立预测可迁移性”的结论只能被有限支持。该结论不应被表述为已建立的因果关系。
VGG 模型的中奖彩票可以在优化器之间迁移（带动量 SGD 与 Adam）
在自然图像分类任务中，使用一种优化器产生的中奖彩票初始化可以迁移到另一种优化器：用带动量 SGD 或 Adam 在 VGG19 上发现的彩票，改用另一种优化器训练时，能够获得与目标优化器直接发现的彩票相近的较高性能。但行为存在优化器相关差异：从 SGD 迁移到 Adam 的彩票在低剪枝比例下有时不如随机彩票，而在高剪枝比例下则优于随机彩票。
观察 H4 提供了一个控制优化器变量的跨优化器实验，支持 VGG19 上的跨优化器迁移。但 weakpoint P2 指出实验仅覆盖单一架构，且图文没有明确数据集，因此证据范围受到限制。结论如果仅限定为所测配置较为可信，若推广到其他架构或数据集则证据不足。
中奖彩票能够在同一数据分布的不同样本子集之间泛化
在包含 25,000 张训练图像、每类 2,500 张图像的 CIFAR-10a 子集上发现的中奖彩票，可以迁移到同一分布下互不重叠的 CIFAR-10b 子集，并相对于随机稀疏初始化改善该留出子集上的训练。该同分布迁移在 VGG19 和 ResNet50 上都成立，但 ResNet50 在低剪枝比例下较敏感，少量权重被剪除时偶尔不如随机彩票。
观察 H5 表明彩票可在留出子集上改善训练，因此支持中奖彩票不只是记忆特定训练样本。但 weakpoint P3 指出结论只基于 CIFAR-10 的一次确定性切分，尚未在其他切分或数据集上复现。因此，该证据支持同分布内可迁移性，但不足以直接建立跨不同数据集或跨数据域的广泛可迁移性。
全局量级剪枝优于逐层剪枝，并产生非均匀的逐层稀疏模式（深层剪得更多）
在 CIFAR-10 上训练 VGG19 并发现中奖彩票时，将所有层的权重放在一起按量级排序、全局删除最小权重，得到的稀疏子网络性能高于每层按固定比例剪枝的逐层剪枝。在全局量级剪枝下，各层剪枝比例并不相同：更深的卷积层被剪得更多，而浅层、尤其第一卷积层保留了更大比例的参数。
观察 H6 对全局剪枝和逐层剪枝进行了直接实证比较，并显示逐层稀疏模式不均匀。但 weakpoint P4 指出实验只覆盖 CIFAR-10 上的 VGG19，因此在其他架构和数据集上的推广仍待验证。结论在所测配置上成立，但其普遍性有限。
掩码结构包含大量信息；公平的随机基线必须随机化掩码结构
对于在 CIFAR-10 上训练的 VGG19，剪枝掩码的结构包含对训练稀疏网络有用的重要信息。比较保留的彩票掩码、仅在层内置换的掩码和跨所有层全局置换的掩码可见：层内置换使性能中度下降，而全局置换导致性能显著下降。因此，用于评估中奖彩票初始化的公平“随机彩票”基线应同时随机化权重值和掩码结构，因为保留逐层掩码统计会从已发现的彩票中携带信息。
§3.1 随机掩码; Appendix A.2 随机化掩码
观察 H7 通过清晰的消融实验表明，掩码结构在两个层面都携带信息，支持随机基线必须随机化掩码结构的主张。但 weakpoint P5 指出证据仅来自 CIFAR-10 上的 VGG19，尚未在其他架构或数据集上验证。方法学建议在该设置中依据充分，跨任务推广仍需谨慎。

为了在自然图像分类的大模型、大数据集场景中得到有竞争力的中奖彩票，论文采用每轮剪除剩余参数 20%、最多 30 轮的迭代量级剪枝，并将参数延迟重置到训练早期。Fashion-MNIST、SVHN、CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 重置到第 1 个 epoch 后的参数，ImageNet 和 Places365 重置到第 3 个 epoch 后的参数。学习率退火和其他超参数按模型族匹配：VGG19 训练 160 个 epoch，在第 80、120 个 epoch 降低学习率；ResNet50 训练 90 个 epoch，在第 50、65、80 个 epoch 降低学习率。

观察 H8 证明该延迟重置与迭代剪枝流程能够在六个数据集的大模型上成功产生中奖彩票，从而支撑后续迁移实验。这里没有发现直接的 weakpoint；该日程作为论文中的有效流程得到验证，但并不意味着这些超参数在所有场景中最优。

values: In the context of supervised image classification with over-parameterized convolutional networks (VGG19 and ResNet50), researchers sought initialization schemes that permit training highly sparse subnetworks to high performance without requiring repeated full-model search per target task. Prior practice produced winning-ticket initializations by performing iterative magnitude pruning and resetting within the same dataset/optimizer as evaluation; this approach is computationally costly (many full-model re-trainings, e.g., 30 pruning iterations) and leaves open whether the discovered initialization encodes only dataset-specific information or a broader inductive bias. If winning tickets were dataset-specific, then each new target dataset would require the same expensive search, preventing amortization; if they were generic, a small set of winning tickets could be reused. Prior work did not systematically test cross-dataset transfer within the same data domain, so it was unknown whether tickets from large datasets like ImageNet embed transferable structure useful across varied natural-image classification tasks.

在使用过参数化卷积网络（VGG19 和 ResNet50）进行监督图像分类时，研究者希望找到一种初始化方案，使高度稀疏的子网络无需针对每个目标任务反复搜索完整模型，也能训练到较高性能。以往通常在与评估相同的数据集和优化器上，通过迭代量级剪枝和参数重置来发现中奖彩票初始化；这种方法计算成本很高（例如需要 30 轮剪枝与多次完整模型重训），而且尚不清楚所得初始化只编码了特定数据集的信息，还是包含更广泛的归纳偏置。如果中奖彩票依赖特定数据集，每个新目标数据集都要重复昂贵搜索；如果它们具有通用性，则可以复用少量中奖彩票。此前工作没有系统检验同一数据域内的跨数据集迁移，因此尚不知道 ImageNet 等大型数据集得到的彩票是否包含可用于多种自然图像分类任务的可迁移结构。

Practitioners need guidance about how to choose or construct source datasets for producing reusable winning-ticket initializations. Prior to this study, it was unclear whether increasing only the number of examples, only the number of classes, or both would yield more generic tickets. Without this knowledge, attempts to amortize the expensive ticket-discovery process risked choosing suboptimal source datasets that yield tickets that do not generalize, meaning the search cost could not be shared across tasks. Understanding which dataset properties correlate with transferability is necessary to decide whether investing computation into large, class-rich source datasets (e.g., ImageNet/Places365) will produce broadly useful initializations.
实践者需要知道应如何选择或构造源数据集，以产生可复用的中奖彩票初始化。在本研究之前，尚不清楚仅增加样本数、仅增加类别数，或同时增加两者，哪一种能得到更通用的彩票。缺少这一知识时，为摊销昂贵的彩票发现成本而选择源数据集，可能选中只能产生低泛化彩票的次优数据集。弄清哪些数据集属性与可迁移性相关，是判断是否值得在 ImageNet、Places365 等大型且类别丰富的数据集上投入计算的前提。

It was unknown whether the beneficial initialization captured by a winning ticket is optimizer-specific because different optimizers follow different optimization trajectories and may make different regions of parameter space reachable. If tickets were optimizer-specific, then for each optimizer of practical interest a separate, expensive ticket discovery would be required, limiting reusability. Prior empirical work had not measured cross-optimizer transfer systematically (e.g., SGD ↔ Adam) while controlling other factors, so it remained an open question whether a ticket's inductive bias is tied to the optimization algorithm used to find it.
中奖彩票所包含的有益初始化是否依赖特定优化器，过去并不清楚，因为不同优化器遵循不同的优化轨迹，也可能到达参数空间的不同区域。如果彩票依赖优化器，则每种实际使用的优化器都需要单独进行昂贵的彩票搜索，复用价值会受到限制。此前实证工作没有在控制其他因素的情况下系统测量跨优化器迁移（例如 SGD 与 Adam 之间的迁移），因此彩票的归纳偏置是否与发现它的优化算法绑定，仍是开放问题。

Before reuse of winning tickets across datasets could be plausibly advocated, it was necessary to check whether discovered tickets merely encode idiosyncratic information about the exact training samples used (overfitting to sample draws). If a ticket were specific to the random sample ordering or particular subset, it would not be reusable even across similar data. Prior studies did not separate sample-level overfitting from distribution-level transfer; establishing within-distribution generalization is a first step toward arguing for broader dataset- or domain-level portability.
在主张中奖彩票可以跨数据集复用之前，需要先检查所得彩票是否只编码了所用训练样本的偶然特征，即是否过拟合于具体样本抽取。如果彩票依赖随机样本顺序或特定子集，那么即使面对相似数据也无法复用。此前研究没有区分样本层面的过拟合与分布层面的迁移；证明同分布内的泛化，是进一步论证跨数据集或跨数据域可迁移性的第一步。

Pruning methodology determines the mask structure and hence the remaining sparse architecture; prior work employed different pruning regimes without a unified treatment of their comparative effects on winning-ticket quality and mask statistics. If layerwise pruning forces the same pruning fraction in small early layers it can leave too few parameters in those layers and harm expressivity; conversely, global pruning can adapt pruning intensity across layers but its effects on transferability and mask information content were not fully characterized. Understanding which pruning modality yields stronger tickets and what layerwise sparsity patterns emerge was necessary to choose an effective pruning pipeline for transferable tickets.
剪枝方法决定掩码结构以及最终保留的稀疏架构。既有工作采用了不同剪枝机制，但尚未统一比较它们对中奖彩票质量和掩码统计的影响。逐层剪枝若强制每层使用相同剪枝比例，可能使参数本就较少的浅层保留过少参数并损害表达能力；全局剪枝可以按层调整剪枝强度，但其对可迁移性和掩码信息量的影响尚未充分刻画。因此，需要确定哪种剪枝方式能产生更强的彩票，以及会形成怎样的逐层稀疏模式。

Prior comparisons between winning tickets and "random" sparse initializations sometimes retained the discovered ticket's mask for the random baseline, confounding whether performance differences arose from preserved connectivity patterns or the retained initial weight values. This ambiguity prevented clear attribution of what aspect of a winning ticket—mask topology or initial weight values—drives its training advantage, and could lead to overestimating the novelty of weight-value effects. A controlled assessment of mask permutations was therefore needed to define appropriate baselines and to isolate what is being transferred when reusing winning tickets.
以往将中奖彩票与“随机”稀疏初始化比较时，有时会在随机基线中保留中奖彩票的掩码，因此无法区分性能差异究竟来自保留的连接结构，还是来自保留的初始权重值。这种混淆使人难以判断中奖彩票的优势由掩码拓扑还是初始权重驱动，也可能高估权重值本身的新颖作用。因而需要通过受控的掩码置换实验来定义恰当基线，并明确复用中奖彩票时究竟迁移了什么。

Prior demonstrations of lottery-ticket phenomena in large-scale settings encountered failures when applying the naïve reset-to-zero-iteration strategy, and follow-up work proposed late resetting as a remedy; however, reproducing winning tickets at scale requires a concrete, tuned pruning/reset schedule and training hyperparameters to be specified and validated. Without such a specified pipeline, experiments on large datasets and deep architectures risk failing to produce winning tickets simply due to suboptimal schedules rather than absence of sparse trainable subnetworks. Practitioners needed validated schedules and resetting heuristics for producing tickets that can be evaluated for transfer.
此前在大规模场景中复现彩票假说时，直接重置到第 0 次迭代的朴素策略曾出现失败，后续工作提出延迟重置作为补救。但要在大规模模型上复现中奖彩票，还必须明确并验证具体的剪枝/重置日程和训练超参数。若缺少经过验证的流程，大型数据集和深层架构上的实验可能只是因为日程不佳而无法得到中奖彩票，而不是因为不存在可训练的稀疏子网络。实践者因此需要一套已验证的日程和重置启发式方法。
Winning tickets from large natural-image source datasets transfer across natural-image target datasets with near target-specific performance
大型自然图像源数据集得到的中奖彩票可迁移到自然图像目标数据集，性能接近目标任务专用彩票

Winning-ticket initializations discovered by iterative magnitude pruning (iterative pruning rate 0.2, up to 30 pruning iterations; late resetting to early training iterations) on large, complex natural-image source datasets (ImageNet and Places365, and to a lesser extent CIFAR-100) produce sparse initializations that, when used to train a VGG19 or ResNet50 architecture on other natural-image target datasets (SVHN, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet, Places365), frequently achieve test accuracies on the target tasks that are close to the accuracies obtained by winning tickets discovered directly on those target datasets. The transferability is observed across a wide range of pruning fractions (including very high sparsity), and larger / more class-rich source datasets produced stronger cross-dataset transfer than smaller sources (e.g., CIFAR-100 tickets generalize better than CIFAR-10 tickets despite both having 50,000 training examples).

在大型、复杂的自然图像源数据集（ImageNet、Places365，以及较弱程度上的 CIFAR-100）上，通过迭代量级剪枝发现的中奖彩票初始化（每轮剪枝率 0.2，最多 30 轮，并延迟重置到训练早期参数），用于在其他自然图像目标数据集（SVHN、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、ImageNet、Places365）上训练相同的 VGG19 或 ResNet50 架构时，往往能取得接近直接在目标数据集上发现的彩票的测试准确率。这种迁移在广泛的剪枝比例下都能观察到，包括极高稀疏度；大型、类别更丰富的源数据集通常比小型源数据集产生更强的跨数据集迁移，例如训练样本数相同的 CIFAR-100 彩票比 CIFAR-10 彩票泛化更好。

Source dataset scale and number of classes predict transferability of winning tickets
源数据集规模和类别数量可预测中奖彩票的可迁移性

Winning tickets discovered on larger source datasets—both in terms of number of training examples and number of output classes—transfer substantially better to other natural-image classification datasets (SVHN, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet, Places365) than tickets discovered on smaller source datasets, for both VGG19 and ResNet50 architectures. This effect is not solely explained by raw training-set size: holding training-set size fixed, a source dataset with many classes (CIFAR-100, 100 classes) produced tickets that generalized better across targets than one with few classes (CIFAR-10, 10 classes).
在 VGG19 和 ResNet50 两种架构上，从训练样本更多、输出类别更多的大型源数据集中发现的中奖彩票，迁移到其他自然图像分类数据集时，明显优于从小型源数据集中发现的彩票。这一效应不能只用原始训练集大小解释：在训练样本数相同的情况下，类别更多的 CIFAR-100（100 类）产生的彩票，比类别较少的 CIFAR-10（10 类）产生的彩票在多个目标任务上泛化更好。

However, premise P1 identifies a critical confound: the comparison between CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 does not control for other dataset properties beyond class count, so the specific claim that number of classes independently predicts transferability is not firmly established. The conclusion's scale aspect is well-supported, but the class-count aspect remains uncertain."}
Winning tickets can generalize across optimizers (SGD w/ momentum and Adam) for VGG models
VGG 模型的中奖彩票可以在优化器之间迁移（带动量 SGD 与 Adam）

Winning-ticket initializations generated with one optimizer generalize to training with a different optimizer on natural-image classification datasets: VGG19 tickets found using SGD with momentum or using Adam, when re-used with the alternate optimizer, achieve high performance that is comparable to tickets discovered under the target optimizer. There are optimizer-dependent nuances in behavior: tickets transferred from SGD to Adam sometimes under-perform random tickets at low pruning fractions but outperform random tickets at high pruning fractions.
在自然图像分类任务中，使用一种优化器产生的中奖彩票初始化可以迁移到另一种优化器：用带动量 SGD 或 Adam 在 VGG19 上发现的彩票，改用另一种优化器训练时，能够获得与目标优化器直接发现的彩票相近的较高性能。但行为存在优化器相关差异：从 SGD 迁移到 Adam 的彩票在低剪枝比例下有时不如随机彩票，而在高剪枝比例下则优于随机彩票。

However, premise P2 points out that the experiment lacks specification of the dataset and is limited to a single architecture (VGG19), making the generality of the conclusion uncertain. The conclusion is supported for the specific configuration tested but cannot be confidently extended to other architectures or datasets without additional evidence."}
Winning tickets generalize across different samples from the same data distribution
中奖彩票能够在同一数据分布的不同样本子集之间泛化

A winning ticket discovered on CIFAR-10a, a subset of the CIFAR-10 dataset containing 25,000 training images with 2,500 images per class, transfers to a disjoint subset CIFAR-10b from the same data distribution and improves training on that held-out subset relative to random sparse initializations. This within-distribution transfer holds for both VGG19 and ResNet50, though ResNet50 showed sensitivity at low pruning fractions (occasionally under-performing random tickets when few weights are pruned).
在包含 25,000 张训练图像、每类 2,500 张图像的 CIFAR-10a 子集上发现的中奖彩票，可以迁移到同一分布下互不重叠的 CIFAR-10b 子集，并相对于随机稀疏初始化改善该留出子集上的训练。该同分布迁移在 VGG19 和 ResNet50 上都成立，但 ResNet50 在低剪枝比例下较敏感，少量权重被剪除时偶尔不如随机彩票。

The conclusion is partially supported but requires validation across multiple splits and datasets."}

When performing magnitude pruning for winning-ticket discovery on VGG19 trained on CIFAR-10, globally ranking weights across all layers and pruning the smallest-magnitude weights globally yields higher-performing sparse subnetworks than pruning a fixed fraction per layer ("layerwise pruning"). Under global magnitude pruning the pruning fractions vary across layers: deeper convolutional layers are pruned more heavily while early layers (notably the first convolutional layer) retain a much larger fraction of their parameters.

The claim is well-supported for the tested configuration but not beyond."}
Mask structure carries substantial information; fair random baselines must randomize mask structure
掩码结构包含大量信息；公平的随机基线必须随机化掩码结构

For VGG19 trained on CIFAR-10, the structure of the pruning mask contains substantial information useful for training sparse networks: comparing (a) preserved winning-ticket masks, (b) masks permuted only within layers (local permutation), and (c) masks permuted across all layers (global permutation) shows that locally permuting a mask degrades performance moderately while globally permuting the mask degrades performance dramatically. Therefore, a fair "random ticket" baseline for evaluating a winning-ticket initialization should randomize both weight values and mask structure (global permutation), because preserving mask statistics across layers transfers information from the discovered ticket.
对于在 CIFAR-10 上训练的 VGG19，剪枝掩码的结构包含对训练稀疏网络有用的重要信息。比较保留的彩票掩码、仅在层内置换的掩码和跨所有层全局置换的掩码可见：层内置换使性能中度下降，而全局置换导致性能显著下降。因此，用于评估中奖彩票初始化的公平“随机彩票”基线应同时随机化权重值和掩码结构，因为保留逐层掩码统计会从已发现的彩票中携带信息。

However, premise P5 notes that the experiment is limited to VGG19/CIFAR-10, so the generality of the prescription is uncertain. The conclusion is well-supported for the tested setting."}
Late resetting and iterative magnitude-pruning schedule used to obtain winning tickets for large models and datasets
用于大型模型和数据集的彩票发现流程：延迟重置与迭代量级剪枝日程

For obtaining competitive winning tickets in the large-model and large-dataset regime of natural-image classification, an iterative magnitude-pruning schedule with pruning fraction per iteration 0.2 (20% of remaining parameters) over up to 30 iterations combined with late resetting to parameters at a small early training iteration produced effective winning tickets; late resetting settings used were resetting to the parameters after 1 epoch for Fashion-MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and after 3 epochs for ImageNet and Places365. Learning-rate annealing schedules and other hyperparameters were matched per model family (VGG19 trained 160 epochs with LR drops at epochs 80 and 120; ResNet50 trained 90 epochs with LR drops at epochs 50, 65, and 80).
